summary: Superseding TOOL-REXP claim (D2e-2): adds SUPPLEMENTAL canonical-identity enrichment to curated reference-evidence results in scripts/automation/result_explorer.py, on top of the D2d-2 implementation. New behavior: after a curated row is fully scientifically resolved and manifest-cross-checked (unchanged D2d-2 logic), an OPTIONAL sources['identity_yaml'] (automation/registry/experiment_identity.yaml in production, D2e-1, untouched by this claim) is consulted to attach an experiment_identity block: exact-match on reference_evidence_key only (never fuzzy/alias-based -- H15/D8/D8b/A1/H1 are never valid standalone lookup keys), cross-checked against goal/dataset/method_variant/attack/epsilon(1e-9 tight tolerance)/split/evidence_level/protocol_id (only fields both sides represent), with the referenced run_id resolved to exactly one run record. Three states: matched (full canonical identity attached), unavailable (no identity source configured, file missing, malformed YAML, or no mapping -- scientific result unaffected, reason recorded), mismatch (mapping exists but conflicts or is ambiguous -- scientific result unaffected, no canonical identity ever shown). Enrichment ONLY ever adds the experiment_identity key; it never alters metrics, evidence_level, attack, epsilon, split, threshold, confusion counts, or manifest provenance -- proven by test_i3 (byte/value-equivalent scientific fields with vs without identity source) and the real-data smoke queries. Never requires the gitignored checkpoint file a run record references to exist on disk (test_i15, proven both by code inspection -- no filesystem check on checkpoint_or_artifact anywhere -- and empirically with a synthetic nonexistent path). Ordinary (non-reference) ledger rows never receive an experiment_identity block (test_i11). CLI gained an optional identity=<path> source argument, fully backward compatible (all prior invocations work unchanged when omitted). Real-data smoke queries (read-only): H15_eps0015_frozen -> 1 curated result, all scientific fields identical to the pre-D2e-2 committed values, experiment_identity.state=matched, evaluation_id eval_fall_detection_sensefi_ut_har_afac_pgd_eps0p015_frozen_test_v1, display_name 'AFAC frozen-test evaluation under PGD epsilon=0.015', H15 legacy alias meaning=null/meaning_status=unverified. No --split command, no experiment/training/validation/export/threshold-selection script invoked, no checkpoint file read. I4b) covering exact enrichment, scientific-field invariance, missing/malformed identity source, missing mapping, duplicate mapping, epsilon/evidence-level/protocol/run conflicts, ordinary-query non-interference, D2d-2 fallback preservation, no-fuzzy-alias-lookup, structured alias preservation, and checkpoint-independence -- 40/40 total suite pass (24 pre-existing F1-F15+extras, unmodified, still passing + 16 new).
